label: exploratory; n = 3; all three tracks were previously inspected; no independent final test

loocv.note: prior means/SDs come from canonical full-track fits of the OTHER trials only; the held-out fit uses only its own 0/50/100 ms points; those full-track fits are retrospective

initial_acceleration_law_identity.note: same c gives the same total t=0 acceleration in both laws for |c| <= .30

canonical_cap.note: |c| > .30 saturates the canonical law; the constant law does not cap

lateral_sign_symmetry.note: flipping c_lat mirrors exactly the lateral lift; no sign is inherited from the manual start

future_invariance.note: only the measured frames after 0.10 s and the 11 m reference were altered

manual_11_39_baseline.note: factorial uses canonical constants (rho 1.20, g 9.81) and rtol 1e-9; the manual uses rho 1.225, g 9.80665, rtol 1e-7. The closest analogue is const_cl/manual/free3, not a bit-exact rerun.

full_track_fit.note: our replication of the canonical full-track fit must agree with the archived RMSE within 0.30 cm; a larger gap means it is not the same fit

determinism.note: no RNG; multi-start seeds are fixed; scipy fit is deterministic

convergence_summary.note: recorded only; a case without any converged start is flagged here and also by best_converged=false in the table
